summary: Frontend adds a Stripe Checkout redirect flow from the cart, persists buyer/cart context across the redirect, and introduces success/failure pages that verify Stripe session status before creating an order. Admin payments UI is updated to load/save Stripe settings. Backend changes are present but truncated, so key security/persistence requirements around Stripe secret keys and mode-based key usage cannot be fully verified from the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Stripe settings (test/live secret keys and active mode) must persist in the backend canister across reloads/upgrades, and non-admin users must not be able to read Stripe secret keys from any endpoint; checkout session creation must use the secret key for the active mode.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the Admin Payments UI and mentions hooks for admin/public config, but the backend implementation is truncated and does not provide explicit evidence of stable persistence across upgrades, admin-only access control for secrets, or that checkout session creation selects the active-mode secret key.

missing_requirements.requirement: Bonus/earned tokens must be recorded only after Stripe payment success is verified and the order is created.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calculates and displays `bonusTokens` and shows a success toast, but there is no explicit evidence in the diff summary that the backend actually records/awards the bonus tokens only after verified Stripe success (this may exist in truncated backend or in savePurchaseOrder, but it is not shown).

hallucinated_features.description: AI chat tutor behavior/content changes (local AI response generation and chat UI logic changes).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any of REQ-1 through REQ-5; unrelated to Stripe checkout, order creation timing, Stripe settings persistence, or token discount/earning requirements.
